search_text: published ZDI-21-454 ZDI-CAN-12492 Oracle WebLogic Server T3 Protocol Deserialization of Untrusted Data Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2021-04-22 CVE-2021-2211 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-2211 4.9 AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Oracle'] ['WebLogic Server'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Oracle WebLogic Server.
